skill.name: bats-testing-patterns
skill.description: Guides AI coding agents through writing maintainable Bats tests for shell scripts, including fixtures, mocks, assertions, and CI workflows.
skill.summary: Create maintainable Bats test suites for Bash and POSIX shell scripts.

content.value_statement: Shell test suites can miss edge cases and become hard to maintain. This skill provides Bats patterns for fixtures, mocks, CI, and shell compatibility.
actual_capabilities: Explains Bats test file structure and common assertion patterns.
Shows setup and teardown patterns for temporary test directories.
Provides examples for fixtures, mocks, stubs, and environment overrides.
Covers failure testing, dependency checks, and shell compatibility tests.
Includes CI and Makefile examples for running Bats suites.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not execute tests by itself.
Examples use placeholder commands that must be adapted to each project.
It does not replace security review of shell scripts under test.
Some examples assume Unix-like shells and common command-line tools.

use_cases.title: Add Tests To A Shell Utility
use_cases.description: Create Bats tests for normal output, exit codes, and missing argument behavior.

use_cases.title: Standardize CI Shell Checks
use_cases.description: Add repeatable Bats commands to a workflow or Makefile for pull request validation.

use_cases.title: Teach Test-Driven Shell Development
use_cases.description: Use fixtures, mocks, and focused assertions to introduce test-first script changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Basic Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a small script.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the bats-testing-patterns skill to write simple Bats tests for my shell script. Cover success output and one failure case.

prompt_templates.title: Add Fixtures And Cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the bats-testing-patterns skill to design tests that create temporary fixtures, run the script, compare output, and clean up every file.

prompt_templates.title: Mock External Commands
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for scripts with dependencies.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the bats-testing-patterns skill to test a shell script that calls external tools. Include stubs, PATH isolation, and error handling checks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Full Test Suite
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the bats-testing-patterns skill to propose a complete Bats suite for this project, including fixtures, compatibility tests, CI commands, and risk areas.

output_examples.input: A request to test a Bash script that validates arguments and prints status messages.
output_examples.output: A concise Bats test plan covering valid input, missing input, expected output, and exit status assertions.

output_examples.input: A request to test a script that reads files and writes processed output.
output_examples.output: A fixture-based testing approach with temporary directories, copied sample files, output comparison, and cleanup guidance.

output_examples.input: A request to test a script that calls curl and jq.
output_examples.output: A mock-based strategy that stubs external commands, isolates PATH, verifies failure handling, and keeps network calls out of tests.

best_practices: Use one clear behavior per Bats test and give each test a descriptive name.
Create temporary files in setup steps and remove them in teardown steps.
Stub external commands so tests stay fast, deterministic, and offline.
anti_patterns: Do not let tests depend on live network services or mutable host state.
Do not reuse temporary directories without cleanup between tests.
Do not hide broad integration checks inside unit tests without clear boundaries.

faq.question: What is Bats?
faq.answer: Bats is a TAP-compatible testing framework for Bash and shell scripts.

faq.question: Does this skill install Bats?
faq.answer: No. It explains installation options and testing patterns, but it does not install software.

faq.question: Can it test POSIX shell scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance includes compatibility checks for bash, sh, and dash where available.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. The skill includes documentation links, but its testing guidance can be used offline.

faq.question: Can it help with CI pipelines?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for GitHub Actions and Makefile test targets.

faq.question: Should I adapt the examples?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace placeholder functions, paths, and commands with project-specific behavior.
